{{Top|leg}}
The '''Agra Alliance''' was a government on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. The Alliance was composed of [[Alderman|aldermen]] from each region of the planet; the Alliance set prices, controlled agricultural production from the planet's collective [[Farm/Legends|farms]], and tried to ensure fair conditions for all farmers.
